token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Recompile the five immutable R2 source responses after correcting PDF visible-date precedence, without issuing another network or model call.
token_budget_basis.input_scale_basis: One digest-bound R2 terminal, one digest-bound effective plan, five successful immutable response captures and one publication-date defect receipt.
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: Every reused response object must retain its request/response digest, route, source identity and original authority while the corrected Dell PDF records visible header date and later file CreationDate separately.
token_budget_basis.materiality_and_quality_risk: Reusing the invalid R2 source object instead of the immutable raw response would preserve the wrong date; silently refetching would lose exact failure lineage and spend an unnecessary network call.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: R2 captured all five originals, but its Dell IR source object selected 2026-06-06 from PDF CreationDate instead of the visible March 18, 2025 release date. The preserved raw body reproduces the corrected 2025-03-18 decision locally.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Deterministic AI-free capture validation and compilation replay only.
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Abort unless all five predecessor captures are captured and digest-bound, no transport executes, and the Dell IR source resolves to 2025-03-18 with provider telemetry only as corroboration; preserve R2 unchanged.
